passive.name: Evil Caught Within
passive.text: The equipper's CRIT Rate increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**. When the equipper's **Basic Attack** hits an enemy, their ATK increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, and their DMG ignores **15/17.3/19.5/21.8/24%** of the target's **Wind RES** for 16s.

passive.name: Eclipse Effect
passive.text: CRIT Rate increases by 20%. When the equipper is Pyrois, using an **Ultimate** grants the Eclipse effect. When the Eclipse effect is active, DMG dealt by the equipper ignores **16/17.5/19/20.5/22%** of **Ether RES**, lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When the equipper enters combat, they gain the Eclipse effect.

passive.name: Scorching Breath
passive.text: Upon hitting an enemy with a **Basic Attack**, **Dash Attack**, or **Dodge Counter**, the equipper's ATK increases by **3.5/4.4/5.2/6/7%** for 8s, stacking up to 8 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Get Everyone Fired Up
passive.text: When an **EX Special Attack** or **Chain Attack** hits an enemy, the equipper's ATK increases by **6/6.9/7.8/8.7/9.6%** for 8s. While the target is under an Attribute Anomaly, this effect is increased by an additional **6/6.9/7.8/8.7/9.6%**.

passive.name: Knight's Combo
passive.text: Launching a **Dodge Counter** or **Quick Assist** increases the equipper's ATK by **12/13.8/15.6/17.4/19.2%** for 12s.

passive.name: Oversized Barrel
passive.text: Increases ATK by **7.5/8.6/9.7/10.8/12%**. Landing a critical hit on an enemy will inflict an additional 200% of ATK as DMG. This effect can trigger once every **8/7.5/7/6.5/6**s.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Swift Edge
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Launches up to 4 attacks forward, dealing **Wind DMG**.
When the 4th attack hits an enemy, it accumulates 20 Flow.
The 4th attack can dodge enemy attacks upon the moment of activation. Upon successfully dodging an enemy attack, this Basic Attack's DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier are increased to those of **Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind**, and an additional 15 **Flow** is accumulated.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th attack.
When Severian uses a **Dash Attack**, **Dodge Counter**, or **Dodge: Spontaneity** during a **Basic Attack** combo, it does not interrupt the **Basic Attack** combo count.

rows.label: 4th Attack Successful Perfect Dodge DMG Multiplier
4th Attack Successful Perfect Dodge Daze Multiplier

entries.name: Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind
entries.text:
Automatically activates when Severian is attacked at the moment he launches the first three attacks of his Basic Attack, or when he has **Shadowflash** and is hit by a non-Control Skill enemy attack while not invulnerable:
Dashes forward, dealing massive **Wind DMG** to enemies in an area ahead.
Upon activating this skill, accumulates 15 Flow. Upon hitting an enemy, an additional 20 **Flow** is accumulated.
Hold Basic Attack while activating this skill to quickly launch **Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt**. When the final hit of **Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt** is unleashed, it accumulates 20 **Flow**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt
entries.text:
With enough Flow, hold Basic Attack to consume 100 **Flow** and activate:
Dodges backward and charges up, then continuously darts around the field while unleashing slashes, dealing massive **Wind DMG** to enemies in an area in front.
The backward dodge can dodge enemy attacks. Successfully dodging an enemy attack triggers **Vital View** and accumulates 15 **Flow**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Windshift
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
When **Dodge: Windshift** triggers a **Perfect Dodge**, it accumulates 15 Flow. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Sheer Assault
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Launches an attack forward, dealing **Wind DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Fatal End
entries.text:
When **Dodge: Windshift** triggers a **Perfect Dodge**, press Basic Attack to activate:
Launches a quick slash forward, dealing **Wind DMG**.
If switched off-field immediately after triggering a **Perfect Dodge** with **Dodge: Windshift**, this skill is activated automatically.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Spontaneity
entries.text:
After dodging backward, hold Dodge to activate:
Provokes the enemy.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Field Orders
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Dashes forward quickly, unleashing claw strikes and slashes at enemies ahead to deal **Wind DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Provocation Prohibited
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Fight Force with Force
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Unleashes slashes, claw strikes, and cannon fire against enemies in sequence, dealing **Wind DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Entry Skill: Clear Out
entries.text:
When Severian has Windborne and is in combat, press Switch to switch him into battle and activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash against enemies ahead, dealing **Wind DMG**.
Activating this skill is considered activating a **Quick Assist**.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Gale Rend
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Unleashes slashes and stabs forward, dealing **Wind DMG**.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Swiftwind Rupture
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Unleashes a combination of slashes, claw strikes, and cannon fire forward, dealing massive **Wind DMG** and gaining 1 stack of Shadowflash.
Hold EX Special Attack to continuously consume Energy before the cannon attack, and repeatedly launch wind blades that deal **Wind DMG** to enemies.
When reaching the maximum amount of Energy consumed, gains an additional stack of **Shadowflash**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Coldblade Reap
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a series of attacks forward, dealing massive **Wind DMG**.
After using this skill, accumulates 35 Flow.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Annihilating Windstorm
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Unleashes multiple rapid slashes in succession, dealing massive **Wind DMG**.
After using this skill, accumulates 100 Flow.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Endless Breeze
entries.text:
Severian's CRIT DMG increases by **60%**, and his DMG increases by **25%**. If there is another Wind character in the squad, his DMG increases by an additional **30%**.
When Severian uses **Basic Attack: Swift Edge** just before being hit by an enemy attack, he can dodge the attack. If he dodges it with any of the first three hits of his Basic Attack, he automatically launches **Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind**. If he dodges it with the 4th hit, that Basic Attack's DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier are increased to match **Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind**.
When Severian enters the battlefield, he gains 2 stacks of Shadowflash. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
When Severian has **Shadowflash** and is not invulnerable, if he is hit by a non-Control Skill enemy attack that he fails to actively dodge or parry, he consumes 1 stack of **Shadowflash** to automatically dodge the attack and launch **Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind**.
Successfully dodging an enemy attack with **Basic Attack: Swift Edge**, automatically dodging an enemy attack with **Shadowflash**, or directly dodging an enemy attack all count as a **Perfect Dodge**.
**Shadowflash** can stack up to 2 times. If Severian gains **Shadowflash** while already possessing maximum stacks, he gains 1 stack of Windborne instead, and the next **Basic Attack: Swift Edge** is enhanced to **Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind**.
Each time Severian performs a Perfect Dodge, he gains 1 stack of **Windborne**. While Severian has **Windborne** and is in combat, press Switch to switch him from off-field to on-field and launch an **Entry Skill**.
Severian gains Flow by hitting enemies with certain skills or triggering a Perfect Dodge. **Flow** is capped at 150 points.
When **Flow** reaches 100 points, hold Basic Attack to consume 100 **Flow** and launch **Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt**.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Optimal Setup
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is a **Support** or **Stun** character, or shares the same faction:
For every 1% CRIT Rate Severian has, his ATK increases by 8.5. This effect is capped at 100% CRIT Rate.

entries.name: Double Espresso
entries.text:
When Severian uses a **Chain Attack**, the accumulated **Flow** increases to 50.
When Severian switches in through **Entry Skill: Clear Out**, the skill is replaced with a **Chain Attack**. The entry type is not changed, and it is treated as a non-heavy attack. This effect can trigger once every 60s.
Each time Severian uses **Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt**, he gains 1 stack of **Windborne**.
When Severian's attacks hit a target, they ignore 15% of the target's Wind RES.

entries.name: Reins of Reason
entries.text:
When Severian enters the battlefield, he recovers 150 **Flow**. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When Severian triggers a **Perfect Dodge** or uses **Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt**, his PEN Ratio increases by 20% for 25s.

entries.name: The Last Light
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Between Light and Shadow
entries.text:
When Severian enters combat or switches on-field, his ATK increases by 10% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Severian uses **Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind** or **Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt**, his Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10% for 15s.

entries.name: A Heart Above 0°C
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Beneath a Little Star
entries.text:
Severian's max **Flow** increases to 180, and the Flow gained when entering the battlefield increases to 180.
The additional DMG Multiplier of the final hit of **Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt** is increased by a fixed 350%.
Upon using the final hit of **Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt**, Severian gains **Windrise**: Accumulates 5 **Flow** per second for 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
